Name: Mount Naphtali
ModernLocation: Unknown; the hill country of Naphtali in Galilee
Description: The hill country of Naphtali in Galilee, where Kedesh, a city of refuge, stood. The name describes the upland region of the tribe, not a single peak.
BiblicalSignificance: Mount Naphtali is the northern hill country where a city of refuge gave safety to those who fled there.
